title: Capstone: An Environment from Zero
summary: Build a local platform entirely with Terraform: kind clusters for dev and prod, namespaces, Gateway API and Traefik via the helm provider, and the shipit app via a Helm chart, organised into tested modules and separate stacks with remote state in an S3-compatible store, plus CI and an optional AWS stretch goal.
objectives: Design a multi-stack Terraform repository (cluster, platform, app) with clear ownership and data flow
Use an S3 backend against a local S3-compatible store with native lockfile locking and per-environment state keys
Write reusable modules with validated inputs and use them from per-environment variable sets
Deploy a gateway controller and a real application with the helm provider, without two-phase apply problems
Cover modules with `terraform test` unit tests using mocks and overrides
Wire formatting, validation, linting, scanning and tests into a CI workflow
Optionally extend the platform to AWS with explicit cost guard rails
